== Card credits ==
Darren Pilbeam is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the original concept of four cards.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The printed concept credits name the tournament or award with each concept: "2012 EuroWorlds Qualifier" on •Commander Adar Tallon ([[Virtual Block 9]]); "UK Champion 2009" on •Luuke ([[Virtual Block 8]]); "UK Championship 2010" on Maul's Cape ([[Virtual Block 9]]); "UK Championship 2013" on •What About That Blue One? ([[Virtual Block 9]]). The credited cards were printed in [[Virtual Block 8]] (2012) and [[Virtual Block 9]] (2014), so the credited cards span 2012–2014. The full list of people credited on Virtual cards is at [[Card Credits#Darren Pilbeam|Card Credits]].

''Year'' is the set's release date (Virtual Sets) or the date its official text took effect (Virtual Blocks), as given in the set's article. Alternate-image (AI, ALT) and back faces are counted as separate cards, as on [[Card Credits]].
